note: FACTORY ACCOUNTING RE-PIN: ConstraintSugar no longer owns human predicate method names; arbitrary method calls are dug through MethodCallsiteSugar when visible source constrains the universe, while stdlib/specialized sugar still wins by priority. Assertion vocabulary is shape-owned (relation macros, bool macros, if-panic with panic/abort-only divergence), and the broad if-return path is not treated as a constraint. The assertion multiset CID is unchanged; canonical linux coretests still has SILENT 0 and unclassified 0. Counts move because successful method-callsite digs are no longer also counted as standalone impl-method assertions: callsite-expanded obligations drop from 505 to 488, with discharged 6106->6098 and refused 714->705. This is an accounting correction, not a corpus change: same CID, fewer duplicate impl-method rows, no hidden bucket introduced.
